items.raw_excerpt: Leopard numbers are recovering in western Zambia after communities replaced real leopard skins with synthetic furs for traditional ceremonies, conservationists say.
items.summary_en: People in western Zambia used to use real leopard skins in traditional ceremonies. Communities switched to synthetic furs instead. Now leopard numbers are recovering, conservationists say.

items.raw_excerpt: The Taste of the Danforth festival has been on hiatus since 2023 after financial shortfalls, but funding from the province and the city helped bring it back, with the federal government announcing additional support just days before it kicked off.
